details:
- CVE-2026-81634: bounds-check the scratch buffer in rrset_canonical() and
  rrset_canonicalize_to_buffer() before writing the RRSIG rdata, the first
  canonical owner name and each RR's rdata, so a large rrset can no longer
  be written past the end of the buffer
- CVE-2026-80225: cap the number of pipelined TCP/DoT queries drained per
  event-loop visit in tcp_req_info_read_again() and tcp_more_read_again()
  and defer the remainder via a zero-delay timer, so one connection can no
  longer starve the other file descriptors
- CVE-2026-85501: bound the DNSSEC validation work per query (ReTrap): add
  the val-validation-attempts and val-hash-attempts limits (default 32),
  limit DNSKEY/RRSIG and DS key-tag matches and the NSEC/NSEC3 records
  checked per message, shorten oversized referral DS RRsets, stop validator
  restarts once the limits are hit, and require only the answer and
  authority sections to be secure; the built-in val-clean-additional
  default is now no, the shipped unbound.conf keeps val-clean-additional: yes
